newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Honko Int'l seen strong on market debut.
newsitem.headline: Honko Int'l seen strong on market debut.

text.p: Hong Kong-based transistor maker and distributor Honko International Holdings Ltd is expected to get off to a strong start on its Monday market debut but its longer-term performance is less certain, analysts said on Friday.
The company, which offered a total of 67 million shares at HK$1.0 each last week, reported a subscription rate of 34.3 times.
Ben Kwong, director at Dharmala Securities, tipped the stock to open at about HK$1.20 to HK$1.30 on Monday.
"Prices in the grey market are already at these levels," he said, adding those were strong prices for the stock.
Another analyst said the stock should open above issue price because of the high subscription rate.
But brokers were less certain about its longer-term performance.
"The stock is very speculative," said an analyst who declined to be identified. He added its fundamentals were not very attractive.
